title: Jesus, The Visa Got Rejected Again ✈️
topic: his visa was rejected a second time and he can't tell if he's still waiting on a door or banging on a wall

bible.text: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.

lines.text: Jesus... the visa got rejected again. ✈️

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Second time this year. A door, or a wall?

lines.text: Second time this year. I can't tell if I'm waiting on a door or banging on a wall.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Rebuilt? I'm tired of forms, fees, and 'we regret to inform you'.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Rebuilt? I'm tired of forms, fees, and every 'we regret to inform you'.

lines.text: Eagles don't beat their wings harder into the storm. They wait for the wind and rise on it.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Maybe the wait isn't the delay. Maybe it's where strength is rebuilt.

lines.text: What are you still waiting on that nobody knows about?
